name: fo-vat
description: Calculate Faroese MVG for ordinary businesses in 2026 by distinguishing taxable sales, supplies with no output VAT but input recovery, and exempt activities without input recovery. Covers registration, domestic and imported goods, specified foreign services, invoices, credit notes, mixed-use input allocation, vehicles, capital adjustments, refunds, cessation and current quarterly administration. Trigger on Faroe Islands VAT, MVG, foreign services, DKK 50000 registration, input VAT, property use changes, VAT refunds and business transfers. Uses the current VAT Act and proportional-deduction regulation. Records the Q2 payment-date source conflict rather than assuming the return deadline changes the statutory payment clause. Specialist refunds and unresolved foreign-service implementation need separate evidence.
